single-cell RNA-seq.sample_type: CD3+ T cells from lung, lung-draining lymph node, bone marrow, blood, and published tumor-associated T cells
single-cell RNA-seq.readouts: single-cell transcriptomes; gene expression states; T cell subset identities; tissue signatures; activation-state markers

evidence_location.quote: Differential gene expression from the scRNA-seq data resolved T cell subsets and functional states within and between sites and lineages into 10–11 clusters (Fig. 1c, Supplementary Data 3, 4).

qPCR.sample_type: sorted blood CD4+ and CD8+ T cells
qPCR.readouts: NME1, IL2RA, and IFIT3 mRNA fold-change after stimulation or IFN blockade

evidence_location.quote: Expression of NME1 transcripts rapidly increased after TCR-stimulation, peaking between 16 and 24 h and remaining elevated for up to 72 h, for both CD4 + and CD8 + T cells compared to unstimulated controls, a pattern of expression similar to the canonical T cell activation marker IL2RA (Fig. 5a).

flow cytometry.sample_type: tissue and blood T cells; proliferating CD3+ T cells
flow cytometry.readouts: surface-marker phenotype; intracellular NME1 protein; CD25 expression; proliferation-associated protein expression

evidence_location.quote: At the protein level, NME1 expression increased in CD4 + and CD8 + T cells after TCR-mediated stimulation from 24 to 120 h (Fig. 5b, upper), and with each successive round of T cell proliferation, while CD25 was expressed similarly, independent of cell division (Fig. 5b, lower).
